After reading the latest review I feel compelled to update my review. Having spoken to my GP this new system is amazing. They spent a lot of money on locums before they brought it in to clear the back log (routine with the best GPs was a 6 week wait - urgent was still same day appointments). This new system asks questions and then triages patients to red, amber and green. Red being immediate attention needed, amber meaning a couple of days and green being routine. It will then list all available appointments in that category. A patient can choose the GP,  where the appointment is (Bosham or Langley House), an upstairs or downstairs room or a telephone appointment. Routine appointments now seem to be within 2 weeks. It seems to be working well so far. From a person who suffers with mental health and a family member with severe anxiety and Autism I can say that a form is far better as family member does not use the phone and would not go into a place to book. This surgery is amazing and consistently features in the top 12 in West Sussex. The staff work so hard to do their best. The new system is definitely the way forward. People want to look at appointments and choose what's best for them rather than a receptionist  offering and taking a while to get an agreeable time and day! Well done Langley House for being one of the first to implement this system. It has stopped the 8am scramble for urgent on the day appointments as the form opens at  midnight to 5.30pm Monday to Friday. None of the anxiety of waiting on the phone at that time of morning when you are not feeling well.
